## Release

Automated by release-please from the PR title on squash-merge: `feat:` → minor,
`fix:`/`perf:` → patch, `feat!:` → major, `chore:`/`docs:`/`ci:` → none. No labels
needed — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
